objective: Tighten the repo harness so the canonical validation path compiles and tests the mobile package instead of only checking docs and harness artifacts.
environment_prerequisites: Flutter SDK is installed and available on PATH.
The mobile package at mobile/field_work_agent can run flutter analyze and flutter test locally.
success_criteria: Repo-local wrapper scripts exist for mobile analyze and the focused mobile test batch.
The canonical harness path runs those mobile wrappers during repo validation.
Harness docs and failure-ledger notes explain why mobile compile and test coverage is now enforced.
stop_conditions: The required Flutter toolchain is unavailable and the repo-level harness cannot run mobile validation in this environment.
Completing the work would require changing mobile product code instead of harness files.
approval_gates: Expanding the repo harness to run the full mobile test suite instead of a focused deterministic batch.
Adding new non-dev runtime dependencies to support harness execution.
deliverables: Updated harness docs and canonical validation path
notes: Keep make smoke cheap and deterministic.
Use repo-local wrapper scripts under scripts/harness rather than ad-hoc command sequences.
